Linux now exposes status/start/stop/hard-restart tools with exclusive restart ownership. Dual-core and guest soft reboot remain unavailable. Please test PPT and Excel opening in Workspace, Notes and IDE, Word Chinese text/save, ordinary local replies and at least two tool-enabled turns, then Office close/reopen. Cloud/component evidence does not replace iPad testing.
